title: Synthesis, biological evaluation and molecular docking studies of indeno [1, 2-c] pyrazol derivatives as inhibitors of mitochondrial malate dehydrogenase 2 (MDH2).
authors: Ahmadi, Farzaneh; Engel, Matthias; Baradarani, Mehdi M
one_liner_zh: 该研究合成并评估吲哚并吡唑衍生物对MDH2的抑制活性，分子对接仅针对小分子-蛋白，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Hypoxia inducible factor-1 (HIF-1) is a pivotal transcription factor, which is strongly correlated with the induction of angiogenesis, tumor survival, metastasis, and cell proliferation, making it a pivotal therapeutic target for solid tumor therapeutic agents. Herein, a new series of multi-functional chemical probes were designed including principal groups, viz. adamantyl and indene, at various locations of the parent compound LW6. Molecular docking studies were performed on the designed compounds and their relationship with HIF-1alpha and malate dehydrogenase 2 (MDH2). Inhibition of MDH2 by our compounds was expected to decrease the NADH level. Indeed, treatment of the breast cancer cell line 4T1 led to a strong reduction of the NADH concentration. The greatest reduction in NADH production in mitochondria was observed with (E)-3-(4-((3r, 5r, 7r)-adamantan-1-yl) phenoxy)-N-(5-(piperidine-1-carbonyl)-1, 4-dihydroindeno [1, 2-c] pyrazol-3-yl) acrylamide (18: IC(50) = 59 nM), and has the best inhibitory potential under hypoxic conditions (MCF-7: IC(50) = 57 nM). This compound also gave one of the highest docking "higher than the score obtained with LW6 in parallel (-31.63 kcal/mol) in the initial docking runs (PDB Code: 4WLO). Other related compounds with good yields were also synthesized from docking results, and all the synthesized compounds (14, 18, 22, 26, 29, 30) were evaluated in vitro on human adenocarcinoma cell lines.
abstract_zh: 缺氧诱导因子-1（HIF-1）是一种关键的转录因子，与血管生成、肿瘤存活、转移及细胞增殖的诱导密切相关，使其成为实体瘤治疗药物的重要靶点。在此，设计了一系列新型多功能化学探针，包括在金团化合物LW6不同位置引入的主基团，即金刚烷基和茚基。对设计的化合物进行了分子对接研究，并探讨了其与HIF-1α和苹果酸脱氢酶2（MDH2）的关系。我们预期通过化合物抑制MDH2会降低NADH水平。确实，处理乳腺癌细胞系4T1导致NADH浓度显著降低。在线粒体中观察到NADH产生最大减少的是(E)-3-(4-((3r, 5r, 7r)-金刚烷-1-基)苯氧基)-N-(5-(哌啶-1-羰基)-1, 4-二氢茚并[1, 2-c]吡唑-3-基)丙烯酰胺（18: IC(50) = 59 nM），并且在低氧条件下具有最佳抑制潜力（MCF-7: IC(50) = 57 nM）。该化合物在初始对接运行中（PDB代码：4WLO）也给出了最高的对接分数之一，高于平行实验中LW6的得分（-31.63 kcal/mol）。根据对接结果，还合成了其他相关化合物，产率良好，并在人腺癌细胞系上对所有合成化合物（14, 18, 22, 26, 29, 30）进行了体外评估。
